pages.task: See at a glance what to do next (continue the unfinished inventory) and open the new talent report
pages.summary: One clear next action, but the same unfinished item is shown twice and its 0 % state reads as an empty percent sign.

findings.issue: The unfinished «فهرست تعاملی شخصیت» appears twice in a row: the hero card (next_action) and again in «سنجه‌های نیمه‌تمام» with a second «ادامه» button. Two buttons, one task.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks; ISO 9241-112 conciseness
findings.fix: In tpl_my_home filter the going list: t-foreach over going.filtered(lambda a: a.access_token not in (next_action or {}).get('url','')); hide the card when it becomes empty.

findings.issue: An untouched attempt says «۰٪ پاسخ داده‌اید» and offers «ادامهٔ پاسخ‌دهی». The Persian zero is a dot, so the line reads as «· ٪ پاسخ داده‌اید»; «ادامه» is wrong for something never started.
findings.evidence: student_my_375.png hero meta; portal.py home(): label 'ادامهٔ پاسخ‌دهی' whenever state == 'in_progress'
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 interpretability; ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness
findings.fix: When progress == 0: meta «هنوز شروع نکرده‌ای · ذخیره ۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۱۹», button label «شروع». Same rule in the list rows (web_my.xml line 72, web_portal.xml line 40).

findings.issue: Meta «به انتخاب خودتان» (self-chosen) is opaque to a teenager; the unread flash «۱ اعلان تازه دارید.» repeats the bell badge right above it.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 interpretability, freedom from distraction
findings.fix: Replace with «خودت شروع کردی»; drop the flash when the header bell already shows the count (or keep only on 375 where the badge is tiny).

pages.task: Find the finished talent report and the unfinished inventory
pages.summary: Works, but group headings are inconsistent, cards touch, and scoring-version jargon is shown to a student.

findings.issue: Mixed heading model: the first card is titled by status («نیمه‌تمام»), the next by instrument title, with no «نتیجه‌ها» group heading; the cards sit with no gap between them, so they read as one box.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-125 grouping and hierarchy; ISO 9241-112 discriminability
findings.fix:
Add

نتیجه‌ها

above the instrument groups and render instrument titles as h3 inside one card; give .ts-card + .ts-card a margin-block-start: var(--space-4).

findings.issue: «نسخهٔ نمره‌گذاری 1.0» is shown to a 15-year-old on every result row; it is meaningless to them and adds noise.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 conciseness; ISO 9241-210 user context
findings.fix: Show the version only when len(g['rows']) > 1 and versions differ (the only case where it matters), worded «نسخهٔ دیگر؛ با هم مقایسه نکن».

findings.issue: The list does not say who can see each result, although /my does («با ۱ پنل به اشتراک گذاشته شده»).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations (internal consistency); ISO/IEC 25010 self-descriptiveness
findings.fix: Append the same «با N پنل به اشتراک گذاشته شده / فقط تو می‌بینی» hint, linked to /my/sharing.

findings.issue: «مشاهدهٔ همهٔ سنجه‌ها» under the personal list reads as «all my assessments» but opens the public catalog; <title> «سنجه‌های من» differs from the h1 «سنجه‌ها و نتیجه‌ها».
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations (labels match outcome); WCAG 2.2 2.4.2
findings.fix: Link text «سنجه‌های دیگری که می‌توانی انجام بدهی»; additional_title «سنجه‌ها و نتیجه‌ها».

pages.template: ts_talent/views/web_talent.xml:tpl_report (+ ts_talent/models/report.py levels/compare_lines/programs_list; ts_panel report_share.xml, web_my.xml:tpl_report_who_sees_matrix)
pages.task: Understand my own talent profile, know what to do next, print it, and know who else sees it
pages.summary: On a tie (all four fields 60.0) the report names the same fields as best and worst, invents a 'weakest talent' in math and recommends remedial math, in book jargon, over 19 phone screens, with dark-mode text at 1.2:1.

findings.issue: Tie handling produces false and harmful statements. All four fields average 60.0, yet: tile «برجسته‌ترین زمینه: ریاضی، هنر، ورزش و زبان»; «بالاترین میانگین را دارد» and «پایین‌ترین میانگین به زمینهٔ ... می‌رسد» name the SAME four fields; level «استعداد ضعیف» ends with «ضعیف‌ترین استعداد شما ...: «وظیفه‌مندی ریاضی»» although duty in math (53.3) is not the lowest (art and language are 40.0) and math has the student's top academic score (80.0); programs then recommend «آموزش جبرانی ریاضی». Cause: report.py levels() uses w['fields'][0] and SHORT[w['abilities'][0]] on tied lists; compare_lines() prints both sentences regardless of a full tie.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 user engagement (trust, no harm) and use-error robustness; ISO/IEC 25010 user error protection; ISO 9241-112 interpretability
findings.fix: Presentation: when len(w['fields']) == n_fields (or brief.field_score == weak.field_score) replace field comparisons with one sentence «میانگین هر چهار زمینه برابر است (۶۰)؛ این فهرست بین زمینه‌هایت فرقی نشان نمی‌دهد.», drop the field part of the weak sentence and never print element [0] of a tied list (list all, or say «چند زمینه هم‌امتیاز»); hide 'زمینهٔ ضعیف' program and the tile when tied. Whether the engine's programs should be emitted at all on a full tie needs the owner (book rule).

findings.issue: Deficit labels addressed to a teenager: headings «استعداد ضعیف», «ضعیف‌ترین استعداد شما», program kinds «زمینهٔ ضعیف», «توانایی ضعیف», «آموزش جبرانی». For a self-report of a 15-year-old this is labelling, not description.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 user engagement (respect); ISO 9241-210 designed for the real user (15-year-old); project rule: no harmful labelling
findings.fix: In the participant view (not org_view) rename to «جایی که به خودت نمرهٔ کمتری دادی» and «برای رشد»; programs to «فعالیت‌هایی که می‌توانی با مشاورت بررسی کنی». Keep the book terms in org_view. Owner to approve the wording since book terms are canonical.

findings.issue: No plain-language summary. The core interpretation is «تفسیر در هفت سطح» (کلّی، اجمالی، ترکیبی، کانونی، تفصیلی...) with constructs such as «کنش نوسودمندی» and «ترکیب کانونی: «نوسودمندی تحلیلی در زمینهٔ تعاملی «هنر» با «ریاضی»»» (nested quotes), plus a table row «ترکیب آموزشی». A student cannot tell what the report says about them.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 interpretability, conciseness; ISO/IEC 25010 appropriateness recognisability; ISO 9241-11 effectiveness
findings.fix: Add, right under the tiles, a «خلاصه برای تو» card with at most three plain sentences generated from the same interp (highest ability, field spread or tie, one suggestion). Move «تفسیر در هفت سطح», «جدول کامل» and «دربارهٔ این سنجه» into collapsed sections (button + aria-expanded, not <details>) titled «جزئیات برای گفتگو با مشاور»; add a one-line gloss next to each construct name the first time it appears.

findings.issue: All four fields carry a careless-response flag, but it appears 8 times as small grey lines («این زمینه با احتیاط خوانده شود (پاسخ یکسان یا بسیار سریع)» in each card, «این زمینه با سرعت بسیار بالا پاسخ داده شد» in each chart) while the headline tiles and levels state conclusions without any caveat.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 detectability; ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness (state of the system); ISO/IEC 25010 user error protection
findings.fix: One ts-notice (role=note) above the tiles when any field is flagged: «بخش‌هایی از این سنجه خیلی سریع یا یکسان پاسخ داده شده؛ نتیجه ممکن است دقیق نباشد. درباره‌اش با مشاورت حرف بزن.» Keep a short marker per field, remove the duplicated sentence in cards. Whether a fully-flagged attempt should show interpretation at all is an owner decision.

findings.issue: What to do next is unclear: «گام بعدی» lists book program names (تسریعی، غنی‌سازی، جبرانی) a student cannot act on; the only help link for a worried reader is «تماس با پشتیبانی»; nothing says that the school counselor (who already has the report) is the person to talk to.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness (what happens next); NN/g next-step guidance; ISO 9241-210 context of use
findings.fix: Replace the section head with «قدم بعدی تو» and lead with one action: when shared with an education panel «این گزارش را مشاور «پنل آزمایشی آموزشی» هم می‌بیند؛ وقت گفتگو بگیر و این سه پرسش را با خودت ببر: ...», otherwise the «ارسال برای مشاورم» CTA. Keep programs as secondary text. Change the worry line to «اگر نگران شدی، با مشاور مدرسه یا یک متخصص حرف بزن».

findings.issue: Dark mode contrast failures on the report body: h1.ts-doc__title 1.2:1, dd 1.2:1, p.tt-lead 2.0:1, small 2.0:1. The page title and the meta values (name, date, fields) are practically invisible.
findings.evidence: report.txt row 'dark 375 /my/assessments/131 contrast small. 2.0|h1.ts-doc__title 1.2|p.tt-lead 2.0|dt. 2.0|dd. 1.2'; same rows for the panel report views
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3; ISO 9241-125 colour use
findings.fix: The .ts-doc paper surface keeps a light background or a dark-on-dark text colour in dark mode. Define .ts-doc colours from tokens only (--color-surface, --color-text, --color-neutral-300 for small/dt) and redefine them under the dark theme selector; screen print stays light via @media print.

findings.issue: The report is 12,518 px tall at 375 px (about 19 screens): tiles, 6-row comparison, 4 cards, 4 charts, 7 levels, programs, a 13-row table that scrolls sideways, raw answers, 10 definitions, limitations, two sharing blocks.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-11 efficiency; ISO 9241-112 conciseness; ISO 9241-210 phone-first context
findings.fix: Phone order: summary card (P3-3), comparison rows, per-field charts; everything else collapsed by default with a sticky in-page index (چکیده · زمینه‌ها · جزئیات · چه کسی می‌بیند). Print keeps everything expanded.

findings.issue: False precision and noisy marks: scores have one decimal (۶۸٫۳) while the text says differences under ±8 are not meaningful; in the «کل» row all four bars get «برجسته» because they tie.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 interpretability, discriminability
findings.fix: Participant view: fmt(v, 0); compare_rows: no 'best' mark when all values of the row are equal (render «همه برابر» once).

findings.issue: Contradictory privacy copy: the footer says «این گزارش فقط برای شرکت‌کننده است» while two blocks right below say the panel counselor sees it; the two blocks («چه کسی این نتیجه را می‌بیند؟» and «اشتراک با پنل») repeat the same facts with different terms.
findings.evidence: student_my_assessments_131_1280.txt lines 349-362; web_talent.xml line 344; web_my.xml tpl_who_sees; report_share.xml tpl_report_share_matrix
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 internal consistency; ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations
findings.fix: Footer: «این گزارش متعلق به توست» (drop 'only'). Merge who_sees and report_share into one block: who sees (list) + what they see + link to /my/sharing + one revoke action (see pattern X6).

findings.issue: Definitions section starts mid-argument («از این رو، ابتدا ...»); «خلّاقیّت نظری» and «خلّاقیّت عملی» show the identical sentence; book texts lack نیم‌فاصله (تواناییهای پنجگانه، دانسته ها، نمره های).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 conciseness; Persian typography conventions
findings.fix: Start the quote with a complete sentence (or prefix «به گفتهٔ کتاب:»); split the CRT/CRP sentence into two definitions; apply ZWNJ normalisation to definition texts (items stay verbatim).

pages.task: Send my result to my counselor using the panel code
pages.summary: For this result (taken by invitation) sharing by code can never succeed, but the page asks for a code and fails only after two steps.

findings.issue: Dead end: attempt 131 has workspace_id (invited), and ts_share_attempt() always raises «این نتیجه قابل ارسال برای مشاور نیست.» for such attempts, yet the page shows the code form and a confirm step, and does not say the result is already shared with «پنل آزمایشی آموزشی».
findings.evidence: student_my_assessments_131_share_1280.txt; panel.py share_form() lines 146-158 (no check); assignment.py line 198
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness (prevention), suitability for the task; ISO/IEC 25010 user error protection
findings.fix: share_form: if at.workspace_id or at.source == 'import', render a state card instead of the form: «این نتیجه به دعوت «پنل آزمایشی آموزشی» انجام شده و همان پنل آن را می‌بیند. برای دیدن یا لغو اشتراک به «چه کسی می‌بیند» برو.» with a link to /my/sharing. Also show existing active shares above the form for self-taken results.

findings.issue: The code field has no hint of where the code comes from or what it looks like; the error only appears after submit.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-143 input formats and examples; WCAG 2.2 3.3.2
findings.fix:
Add

کد را از مشاور مدرسه‌ات بگیر؛ چند حرف و عدد انگلیسی است، مثل EDU-4K7Q.

and aria-describedby on the input (use the real code format).

findings.issue: Page title «ارسال نتیجه برای مشاور» vs report CTA «ارسال برای مشاورم» vs /my/sharing «ارسال برای مشاور»; the copy names the recipient «مشاور پنل» while /my/sharing calls the person «کارشناس مسئول».
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 internal consistency
findings.fix: One label everywhere: «ارسال برای مشاورم»; one role word «مشاور» in participant pages (see pattern X4).

pages.task: Understand who can see my result, who has opened it, and stop sharing
pages.summary: The facts are there, but the opening log is an unreadable run of nine identical entries and revoking is one unconfirmed click that the student cannot undo.

findings.issue: «دیده‌شدن‌ها:مشاور (۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۱۹)، مشاور (۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۱۹)، ... مالک پنل (۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۱۹)» - nine near-identical items in one run-on paragraph, no times, no grouping, missing space after the colon. A teenager cannot answer 'who looked at my report and when'.
findings.evidence: student_my_sharing_1280.txt line 27; student_my_sharing_375.png; portal.py _views() returns (role, day) per event, limit 20
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 conciseness, interpretability; ISO 9241-125 grouping
findings.fix: Group in the controller by role: [(role, count, last datetime)] and render a small list: «مشاور: ۳ بار، آخرین بار ۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۱۹ ساعت ۰۶:۳۰» / «مالک پنل: ۶ بار، ...». Label «چه کسانی گزارش را باز کرده‌اند». Presentation only; the audit query stays as is.

findings.issue: «لغو اشتراک با این پنل» posts immediately (no confirmation, no consequence copy). For an invited result the student cannot share it again (can_share is False when workspace_id is set; ts_share_attempt refuses), so one mis-tap is irreversible for the student.
findings.evidence: web_my.xml lines 195-198; portal.py sharing() can_share; report_share.xml lines 29-32 (same on the report)
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness (confirmation before destructive actions), controllability; ISO/IEC 25010 user error protection
findings.fix: Make the button open a confirm page/step: «بعد از لغو، «پنل آزمایشی آموزشی» دیگر گزارش تو را نمی‌بیند. اگر بعداً پشیمان شدی، باید از مشاورت دعوت تازه بگیری.» with «بله، لغو کن» and «انصراف». Whether the student may re-share an invited result is an owner decision (server logic).

findings.issue: «کارشناس مسئول: هنوز تعیین نشده» is unexplained: the student cannot tell whether that means nobody sees it or everybody in the panel does (owner/counselors do see it, as the log shows).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness; ISO 9241-112 interpretability
findings.fix: State who sees it in plain words before the details: «در این پنل، مالک پنل و مشاوران آن گزارش نیمرخ تو را می‌بینند. هنوز مشاور مشخصی برایت تعیین نشده.»

findings.issue: Help link text «این چیست؟» does not say what it explains.
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4; ISO 9241-112 interpretability
findings.fix: «اشتراک چطور کار می‌کند؟».

pages.task: Download a copy of my data or ask for it to be deleted
pages.summary: Clear two-card layout, but deletion is submitted without a confirmation step and the export silently omits answers the student can see on the report.

findings.issue: «ثبت درخواست حذف» files the erase request right after re-authentication, with no confirmation page listing consequences (results, shares with the school panel, whether the account stays, whether it can be cancelled). Re-authentication is not a confirmation.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness, controllability; GOV.UK 'check answers' pattern
findings.fix: Add a confirm step (GET /my/privacy/erase/confirm) with a summary of what will be removed, a required checkbox «می‌دانم این کار برگشت‌پذیر نیست» (or the cancel window if one exists) and the POST button there.

findings.issue: The export states «پاسخ‌های خام و کلید نمره‌دهی در آن نیست» although the student can view their own answers on the report («نمایش پاسخ‌های من»); the reason is not given. «نمایه» is an unclear word for a teenager.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations; ISO/IEC 25010 user engagement (trust)
findings.fix: Owner to decide whether own answers belong in the access copy; meanwhile explain why («پاسخ‌هایت را در صفحهٔ هر گزارش می‌بینی»). Replace «نمایه» with «اطلاعات حسابت».

pages.task: Read the 'result ready' notice and open the result
pages.summary: English browser title, no participant navigation, three equal-weight controls and a generic message.

findings.issue: Browser/tab title is English: «TS panel: notification center | تلنت سرچ». additional_title="title" resolves to the view record name.
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 2.4.2, 3.1.2; project rule: no English UI words
findings.fix: <t t-call="website.layout" additional_title.f="اعلان‌ها">; check notification_prefs the same way.

findings.issue: No participant subnav (every other /my page has it), and the filter «فقط خوانده‌نشده‌ها», link «ترجیح‌های اعلان» and action «همه را خوانده‌شده کن» are three button-like controls that wrap into a ragged block above a single notification.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations (consistent patterns); ISO 9241-125 hierarchy
findings.fix: Add <t t-call="ts_panel.my_nav" active="notifications"/>; render the filter as two tabs («همه» / «خوانده‌نشده») with aria-current, move «ترجیح‌ها» to a quiet link at the end, show «علامت‌گذاری همه به‌عنوان خوانده‌شده» only when unread > 1.

findings.issue: The notice says only «نتیجهٔ شما آماده است» - which result is not named; pill «تازه» runs into the title text in the page text («تازه نتیجهٔ شما...»).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 interpretability; WCAG 2.2 1.3.1
findings.fix: Title «نتیجهٔ «فهرست تعاملی استعداد» آماده است» (instrument name in the notification record or rendered from its url); put the pill inside a visually-hidden-separated span («تازه: »).

pages.task: See where I am signed in and sign out other devices
pages.summary: Functional; naming differs from the account hub and the only primary action is pointless when there is no other device.

findings.issue: Page is «نشست‌های من» but the account hub links it as «دستگاه‌های واردشده»; device shown as raw «Linux Chrome» in the Persian FD font without bdi.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 internal consistency; Persian/RTL: Latin strings in <bdi dir=ltr>
findings.fix: h1/title «دستگاه‌های واردشده»; render «<bdi dir='ltr'>Chrome</bdi> روی <bdi dir='ltr'>Linux</bdi>».

findings.issue: With only the current device listed, the page still shows the primary button «خروج از دستگاه‌های دیگر» (which also triggers re-authentication).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 suitability for the user's tasks (no needless steps)
findings.fix: t-if="len(sessions) > 1" on #ses-others; otherwise «فقط همین دستگاه وارد حساب توست.»

pages.task: Add and verify my mobile number
pages.summary: Clear purpose copy, but heading levels skip, the format example is placeholder-only and the page is cut off from the account navigation.

findings.issue: Heading levels jump from h1 to h3 («تأیید شمارهٔ موبایل», «شمارهٔ تأییدشده», «هنوز فعال نشده است»).
findings.evidence: report.txt 'heading-skip h1>h3' for /my/phone (375 and 1280); web_sms.xml lines 59, 64, 79
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1; ISO 9241-125 hierarchy
findings.fix: Change those h3 to h2.

findings.issue: The only format example is the placeholder 09123456789, which disappears on typing; no visible hint; «حذف شماره» acts without confirmation.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-143 input formats and examples; WCAG 2.2 3.3.2
findings.fix: Visible hint with aria-describedby: «۱۱ رقم، مثل <bdi dir='ltr'>09123456789</bdi>»; confirm text on remove («بعد از حذف، پیامک «نتیجه آماده است» نمی‌گیری»).

findings.issue: No participant subnav and no way back to «حساب من»; the page uses the generic ts-section layout instead of the /my layout.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 controllability, conformity with user expectations
findings.fix: Call ts_panel.my_nav (active='account') when ts_panel is installed (inherit view in ts_panel) or add a «بازگشت به حساب من» ts-back link.

pages.task: Change my name and reach privacy, sharing and security settings
pages.summary: Well-structured hub; the login identifier is rendered with a Persian digit glyph.

findings.issue: The sign-in name shows «ts.pv۲.edu.student@...»: it is wrapped in <span dir=ltr>, which keeps the FD font with Persian digit glyphs, so a user who types it from the screen enters the wrong login.
findings.evidence: student_my_account_375.png («نام ورود»); report.txt '[ascii-digits 1]' for /my/account; web_my.xml line 132; ts.scss line 54 only switches font for bdi[dir=ltr]
findings.standard: Persian/RTL rule: Latin only in codes/emails inside <bdi dir=ltr>; ISO 9241-112 discriminability
findings.fix: <bdi dir="ltr" t-out="user.login"/>.

findings.issue: The name hint says who sees the name but not what to enter (a student may type a nickname that then appears on the school report).
findings.standard: ISO 9241-143 field guidance
findings.fix: «نام و نام خانوادگی‌ات را همان‌طور بنویس که مدرسه می‌شناسد؛ این نام در گزارش و برای پنل‌هایی که نتیجه را می‌بینند نمایش داده می‌شود.»

pages.task: Answer 10 Likert statements per page and continue later if needed
pages.summary: Clear 5-point scale with labels, but on phones the statement text sits on the card border and wraps across it, and the sticky bar can cover the focused question.

findings.issue: Each statement is a <legend> rendered on the fieldset border: the first line straddles the card's top edge and wrapped statements split across it («در انجام تکالیفم پشتکار و سختکوشی» on the border, «دارم» inside). Hurts reading on the core task.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-125 alignment, typography; WCAG 2.2 1.4.10
findings.fix: fieldset { border: 0; padding: 0; margin: 0; min-inline-size: 0 } and draw the card on li.ts-q; or legend.ts-q__text { float: inline-start; width: 100% } + .ts-scale { clear: both }.

findings.issue: The sticky .ts-qnav bar (≈110 px: primary button + quiet link) overlays the lower questions; keyboard focus moving to the next radio group can end up hidden behind it.
findings.standard: WCAG 2.2 2.4.11 focus not obscured
findings.fix: html { scroll-padding-block-end: 140px } on the player page (or .ts-q { scroll-margin-block-end: 140px }).

findings.issue: Two exits with different names: header «ذخیره و خروج» and bottom «ذخیره و ادامه در زمانی دیگر»; the bottom one is a plain link to /my/assessments, so answers on the current page are saved only if the autosave JS already ran.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 controllability, use-error robustness (no data loss); ISO 9241-112 consistency
findings.fix: Make it <button type=submit name=go value=exit> (server saves the page then redirects) and use the same label «ذخیره و ادامه بعداً» in header and footer.

findings.issue: Instruction addresses the student with «شما» («هر عبارت را بخوانید و مشخص کنید ... دربارهٔ شما صدق می‌کند»); see pattern X3.
findings.standard: Persian convention: «تو» for students
findings.fix: Audience-aware copy: «هر جمله را بخوان و بگو چقدر دربارهٔ تو درست است.»

pages.task: Decide whether to accept a school panel's invitation and what will be shared
pages.summary: The invitation is addressed to another person, the consent box is pre-ticked, and the question count and time are wrong for the talent inventory.

findings.issue: Signed in as «دانش‌آموز آزمایشی», the page shows «دعوت برای: مهمان آزمایشی» with no warning and no indication of which account is signed in (the header shows no account controls here). Accepting would attach the result and the consent to the wrong person.
findings.evidence: student_invite_..._1280.txt lines 15-16; student_invite_..._375.png (header has only logo and theme toggle); web_org.xml line 383
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness, self-descriptiveness; ISO/IEC 25010 user error protection
findings.fix: Show «با حساب «دانش‌آموز آزمایشی» وارد شده‌ای. این دعوت برای «مهمان آزمایشی» است. اگر این دعوت مال تو نیست، از حساب خارج شو.» with a logout-and-return link, above the form. Whether acceptance must be blocked when names/contacts differ is an owner decision (server rule).

findings.issue: The sharing consent checkbox is pre-checked («اجازه می‌دهم گزارش نتیجه‌ام ... به اشتراک گذاشته شود»), for a minor. Pre-ticked consent is not freely given, explicit consent.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 user engagement (no dark patterns); GDPR Art. 7 / Recital 32; WCAG n/a
findings.fix: Default unchecked, with copy under the button: «اگر تیک نزنی هم می‌توانی سنجه را انجام بدهی؛ نتیجه فقط برای خودت می‌ماند.» Owner decided 'default checked' earlier (CLAUDE.md ts_org), so this needs an owner decision.

findings.issue: «تعداد پرسش ۱۵» and «زمان تقریبی ۸ دقیقه» are wrong for TALENT-INV-15: the student writes 2-8 fields and rates 15 statements per field (30-120 answers). The catalog and detail already say «۱۵ جمله برای هر زمینه» (tpl_catalog_ext), the invite does not.
findings.evidence: student_invite_..._1280.txt lines 17-20; web_org.xml lines 384-385; web_talent.xml lines 355-370
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 self-descriptiveness (what happens next); ISO 9241-112 external consistency
findings.fix: Inherit tpl_invite in ts_talent like tpl_catalog_ext: for mode == 'matrix' show «۱۵ جمله برای هر زمینه (۲ تا ۸ زمینه)» and a duration range.

findings.issue: «نمی‌خواهم شرکت کنم» declines immediately with no confirmation or explanation of what the panel will see.
findings.standard: ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness
findings.fix: Confirm step or inline note: «پنل می‌بیند که دعوت را نپذیرفتی. اگر نظرت عوض شد، از مشاورت دعوت تازه بخواه.»

findings.issue: The «what is shared» list markers render as down-chevrons (look like expandable rows), not check marks.
findings.evidence: student_invite_..._375.png; ts.scss line 290 (.ts-list-check li::before, physical border-left/bottom rotated -45deg)
findings.standard: ISO 9241-112 discriminability; ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations
findings.fix: Use border-inline-start/border-block-end with a non-square box (inline-size 6px, block-size 11px, rotate(45deg) for RTL) or an inline SVG check.

patterns.issue: Participant subnav overflows at 375: only three of four pills fit, «چه کسی می‌بیند» is cut and «حساب» is off-screen with the scrollbar hidden, so on /my/account, /my/privacy and /my/sessions the active tab is invisible and nothing signals more items.
patterns.fix: At <= 480px use a 2x2 grid (grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr) or shorten labels («کارها»، «نتیجه‌ها»، «چه کسی می‌بیند»، «حساب»); if scrolling stays, scroll the .is-on item into view and add an inline-end fade.

patterns.issue: The account pages are inconsistent: /my/notifications and /my/phone have no subnav or back link; header icons are icon-only and their names («سنجه‌های من»، «حساب من») differ from the subnav («سنجه‌ها و نتیجه‌ها»، «حساب»).
patterns.standard: ISO 9241-110 conformity with user expectations; ISO 9241-112 internal consistency
patterns.fix: Call ts_panel.my_nav on every participant page (share page: active='results'); use one name per destination in header aria-labels/tooltips and subnav.

patterns.issue: Student-facing copy uses «شما» throughout (home, list, report, player, sharing, invite) although the project rule is «تو» for students.
patterns.standard: Persian conventions (project rule); ISO 9241-210 designed for the real user
patterns.fix: Introduce an audience flag (participant age band / panel purpose education + student client) and a t-if pair for key strings, starting with the report, player and invite. How the age band is known is an owner decision.

patterns.issue: One concept, many words: «پنل» / «مؤسسه» / «سازمان» / «مرکز» for the school panel, «مشاور» / «مشاور پنل» / «مشاور مسئول» / «کارشناس مسئول» for the counselor.
patterns.standard: ISO 9241-112 internal consistency; project rule one term per concept
patterns.fix: Participant pages: «پنل» + its name for the organisation, «مشاور» for the person; replace «مؤسسه و مشاور مسئول» (invite), «کارشناس مسئول» (sharing), «اشتراک با سازمان» (report) accordingly.

patterns.issue: LTR identifiers wrapped in <span dir=ltr> or bare text keep the FD font, so Latin digits become Persian glyphs (login, device names).
patterns.standard: Persian/RTL rule: Latin codes/emails in <bdi dir=ltr>
patterns.fix: Replace span[dir=ltr] by bdi[dir=ltr] (or add span[dir=ltr] to the ts.scss line 54 selector).

patterns.issue: Destructive or consent-changing actions submit on one click with no confirmation or consequence text: revoke share (sharing page and report), erase request, decline invitation, remove phone.
patterns.standard: ISO 9241-110 use-error robustness, controllability; ISO/IEC 25010 user error protection
patterns.fix: One shared confirm component (ts_panel.confirm_step: title, consequence list, primary «بله، ...», outline «انصراف») used by all five forms; server logic unchanged.
